title: Sykes-Picot assigns a blue zone to France and a red zone to Britain
summary: Sykes-Picot gives France the blue zone and Britain the red zone, to arrange with an Arab state.
body: The Sykes-Picot text says that in the blue area France, and in the red area Great Britain, shall be allowed to establish such direct or indirect administration or control as they desire, to be arranged with the Arab state or confederation. The agreement is a secret Allied partition. It sits beside the McMahon letter, which is not the same map. The wording on the page includes: "functionaries at the request of the Arab state or confederation of Arab states. That in the blue area France, and in the red area Great Britain, shall be allowed to establish such direct or indirect administration or control as they desire and as they may think fit to arrange with the Arab state or confederation of Arab states. That in the brown area there shall be established an international".
